items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Had you known Britt in Los Angeles when you lived here? INTERVIEWEE: I knew his father.

ctx.x: According to a chart I have here prepared by a Frenchman by the name of Jean Portier which is reasonably accurate, it says when you returned to the band in 1960 the other two trombone players were Mitchell Booty Wood D'Letwood and Britt Woodman?

Yes, that's possibly the right ones although there were quite a few changes after that. Booty, his wife, got ill, and he had to return home. And Britt he changed and he quit and he went into something else, and those kinds of things, you know.
Had you known Britt in Los Angeles when you lived here?
